common_output_contract.format: single strict JSON object; no markdown fence and no prose

mechanical: response contains exactly one parseable JSON object
required keys are task_id, decision, findings, missing_or_uncertain, confidence
findings count does not exceed max_findings
every finding has id, statement, evidence, and allowed function
semantic: statement is grounded in supplied input, not outside knowledge
decision is supported by at least one listed finding
evidence points to the relevant source relation rather than copying only
uncertainty is explicit when supplied evidence is insufficient
evaluation.judge_blinding: record model identity separately; normalization does not display it
